nodes.title: Avia Semiconductor HX711 24-bit load-cell ADC datasheet
nodes.where: p.1-2: 10/80 SPS, gain 128 = +/-20 mV full scale; noise is set by the cell and wiring, so the 1 g (20 kg cell) and 0.5 g (1 kg cell) noise used here are assumptions confirmed by T-H1-STAND-CAL

nodes.title: ExpressLRS: range and power settings (pre-flight range check at reduced power)
nodes.where: power levels 10-250 mW selectable in the Lua script; LQ shown in telemetry

nodes.title: Thrust cell 20 kgf bar cell + HX711
nodes.text: Bar load cell rated 20 kgf on the thrust axis, read by an HX711 at 80 SPS; noise +/-1 gf after averaging 8 samples.
nodes.basis: E1 CR-E1-11 asks for a 20 kg cell + HX711; 1 gf noise is typical of a shielded 20 kg bar cell

nodes.title: Torque cell 1 kgf bar cell at 100 mm arm
nodes.text: Motor mount on a bearing axle coaxial with the shaft; reaction torque restrained by an arm of 0.100 m pressing a 1 kgf bar cell (second HX711); noise +/-0.5 gf.
nodes.basis: B4 CR-B4-09 asks for a torque cell; a lever on a bar cell is the cheapest stand design that separates torque from thrust

nodes.title: Cell range >= 1.25 x the largest expected load
nodes.text: Each cell's rated capacity covers 1.25 x the peak load it should see, so an over-prediction of 25 % does not overload it.
nodes.basis: common instrumentation practice (load at <= 80 % of rated capacity)

nodes.title: Two 5 kg x 1 g scales, 0.1 % after calibration
nodes.text: Two identical kitchen/shipping scales, 5 kg capacity, 1 g display step, calibrated against a 2.000 kg check mass (water in a sealed bottle weighed on the Jacobs lab balance) to +/-0.1 % of reading.
nodes.basis: 1 g step is what A1 (T-A1-WEIGH) and A3 (T-A3-WEIGH-PARTS) specify; 0.1 % after a check-mass calibration is conservative for strain-gauge scales

nodes.title: CG jig: two pin pairs 0.220 m apart in x
nodes.text: Two bridges, one per scale, each with two padded pins under the wing outboard of the fins (|y| = 0.45 m): front pins at x = 0.010 m, rear pins at x = 0.230 m (ahead of the elevon hinge). Pin x set with a steel rule and square to +/-0.5 mm.
nodes.basis: the lower half-fins and lower motors block any support inboard of |y| 0.34 m; the rear pins must stay off the elevons (hinge x 0.2496 m)

nodes.title: Tie-down factor 2.0
nodes.text: The restrained-frame run (four motors, props on) is tied down for 2.0 x the net upward force if the limiter fails and all four motors reach C1's limit thrust.
nodes.basis: props-on bench runs are the highest-energy ground test; 2.0 covers a snatch load on a slack strap

nodes.title: ESC 55 A for 10 s
nodes.text: LANRC BLHeli_S 45 A ESC burst rating 55 A for 10 s; a full-throttle step on the stand is held <= 2 s.

nodes.title: Thrust and torque resolution <= 0.5 % / 2 % of hover
nodes.text: The A/B prop comparison must resolve B1's 1.9 % hover-power difference (CL-B1-HOVER-PROP-RATIO 1.019): thrust noise <= 0.5 % of hover thrust, torque noise <= 2 % of hover torque.
nodes.basis: resolution 4 x finer than the difference to detect

nodes.title: Calibrated thrust-cell U95 = 0.5 % of the 2.5 kgf calibration span
nodes.text: After T-H1-STAND-CAL the thrust reading is within 0.5 % of the 2.5 kgf dead-weight span (12.5 gf) anywhere in that span, including drift between the start and end calibration.

nodes.title: Jacobs Institute, UC Berkeley: Labs and equipment
nodes.where: Electronics Lab (studio 110): soldering irons, oscilloscopes and power supplies, multi-meters, Saleae logic analyzer, heat guns. Woodshop: Delta variable-speed drill press, band saw, table saw. Metal shop: Clausing drill press, Bailey 20-ton press, hand tools. nodes.title: Mount-stiffness rig: optical lever and load steps
nodes.text: T-C4-MOUNT-STIFF read by a laser pointer reflected off a 10 mm mirror bonded to the motor can, onto mm paper on a wall L = 3.0 m away (spot moves 2 theta L); a second mirror on the collar subtracts tube and stub rotation. Spot read to +/-0.5 mm. Loads 0.5, 1.0, 1.5 kg at the prop nut. For comparison, C4's two dial gauges (0.01 mm) are 0.030 m apart on the can.
nodes.basis: optical lever is the standard way to read sub-milliradian rotations without a fine gauge; laser pointer and mirror cost < $5 or are team-owned

nodes.title: mount stiff
nodes.equation: a = x_mount - x_prop ; theta = F a / k ; spot = 2 theta L ; u_k = read / spot_pass ; dial = theta(0.5 kg) s

nodes.title: T-C4-MOUNT-STIFF acceptance: spot travel at 1.5 kg (can minus collar)
nodes.how: Card GT-17: net spot travel at 1.5 kg <= this value in y and in z passes CL-C4-D3-MOUNT-K-REQ.

nodes.title: Largest mount-stiffness load / mount proof load

nodes.title: Tap-test acquisition
nodes.text: FFT of FC raw IMU (INS_LOG_BAT_MASK, batch sampler) at 1 000 Hz or more; the sampling rate must be >= 2.5 x the highest frequency to be read (anti-alias margin). A phone accelerometer app (typically ~400 Hz) is used only for the wing modes below 80 Hz.
nodes.basis: Nyquist 2 x plus a 25 % roll-off margin of the IMU's digital low-pass

nodes.title: tap
nodes.equation: f_op = n/60 x {1, 2} at hover, cruise, cap ; window = f_op (1 +/- s) ; fs_req = k max(f_pred, top window)

nodes.title: FC raw-IMU sampling rate used for tap tests
nodes.how: F4/F3 log setting; confirm in the .bin header (T-H1-RIG-CHECK).

nodes.title: Tap-test sampling rate needed
nodes.how: T-H1-RIG-CHECK: log a 200 Hz tuning-fork / phone-speaker tone on the FC raw IMU and find it in the FFT.

nodes.title: Highest frequency a ~400 Hz phone accelerometer reads
nodes.how: Informational: the fin-station modes (~273-281 Hz) and 2P at the cap (312 Hz) are above it (CR-H1-11).

nodes.title: Tube bend rig
nodes.text: Span 0.80 m on two 22 mm dowels, centre load 0.5-4.0 kg through a printed 22 mm saddle; deflection by a dial indicator on a magnetic base (0.01 mm) if Jacobs lends one, else a digital caliper depth rod against a fixed reference bar (0.02 mm read, +/-0.03 mm U95).
nodes.basis: C4's T-C4-TUBE-BEND procedure; caliper fallback from the borrow list

nodes.title: bend
nodes.equation: I = pi/64 (D^4 - d^4) ; delta = F L^3 / (48 E I) ; sigma = F L D / (8 I) ; u_E = u_delta / delta

nodes.title: Bend-test peak stress at 4 kg

nodes.title: Tube modulus relative U95 from the deflection read

nodes.title: Coupon lever frame 6:1, water jugs to 20 kg

nodes.basis: one rig covers every pull test from 50 N to ~1 kN with a hose and two 10 L jugs

nodes.title: Thrust stand calibration and noise
nodes.procedure: Card GT-01: dead weights 0.5/1.0/2.0/2.5 kg on the thrust axis via a pulley-free hook, 50/100/200/500 g at the 0.100 m torque arm; 60 s zero-load noise; before and after every session.

nodes.title: Scale and CG-jig calibration
nodes.procedure: Card GT-06/07: 2.000 kg check mass 10 times per scale; 1.000 kg at a ruled x on the jig, recover x; record in logs/T-H1-SCALE-CAL.csv.

nodes.title: Restraint pull before props-on runs
nodes.procedure: Card GT-13: spring scale (or the lever frame) on each strap to the per-strap force, no slip at the table anchor.

nodes.title: Restrained four-motor run (CR-A2-25)
nodes.procedure: Card GT-13: aircraft strapped at the four root eyes after T-H1-RESTRAINT-PULL; fresh pack; QSTABILIZE, 2 s full throttle: BAT.Curr <= 100 A, each ESC rpm <= the cap (Q_M_SPIN_MAX 0.84), per-motor current <= 25 A from ESC telemetry; then 30 s at hover throttle for compassmot (T-F3-COMPASSMOT).

nodes.title: Pack retention pull with a dummy pack (GT-10)
nodes.procedure: Card GT-10: 680 g plywood/sand dummy strapped as flown; pull 85 N in +-x, +-y, +z with the lever frame or a luggage scale, 10 s each; slip <= 5 mm, hatch stays closed. Never a LiPo.

nodes.title: Arm refusal and kill switch, props off (GT-12)
nodes.procedure: Card GT-12: arm refused with each failed pre-arm check; kill switch at 50 % throttle, 5 trials, switch edge to all RCOU at disarm in the log <= CL-H1-ESTOP-ACCEPT.

nodes.title: Coupon lever calibration
nodes.procedure: Card GT-15 step 0: 2.000 kg check mass on the short-arm hook; balance with water on the long arm; ratio = 2.000 / jug mass; repeat 3x; within 2 % of 6.0.

nodes.title: Readout checks: optical lever, tube deflection, tap acquisition, inclinometer
nodes.procedure: Optical lever: 1.00 mm shim under the mirror base edge, spot step matches 2 L t/b; caliper or dial on a 1.00 mm gauge block; FC raw IMU logs a 200 Hz phone-speaker tone at the right bin; phone inclinometer against a 30 deg printed wedge.
